counterexampleDATAOnly: A never reached: no alarm armed
findings.explanation: R is the first ready-ancestor sample, A is later independent alarm arming. An ancestor that samples R but never reaches A has no active alarm; remaining R+120-now and later refusal cannot retroactively cover R..A. The plan correctly applies this reasoning to O..A but the R alternative needs the same explicit qualification. This is DATA precision, not an observed failure or unchanged-source defect.
findings.requiredDisposition: Keep the entire pre-arm interval including R..A explicitly outside demonstrated independent enforcement unless a separately reviewed already-armed mechanism or exact fault-domain qualification actually covers it. Choosing R alone is insufficient. Preserve unchanged O-inclusive120 and O-based normal115; adopt neither R nor A, initialization exclusions or weakened failed-path scope here. Root dispositions any future source/mechanism separately.
findings.title: R precedes alarm arming A; R adoption alone does not cover R..A
